notes: This file is a seed registry template, not a completed corpus inventory.
Store prompt text locally only when the source and license or ToS allow it.
When direct storage is not allowed, keep hash, provenance, and feature-only records.

source_type_definitions.official: Official SAIR competition resources or officially released artifacts.
source_type_definitions.contributor_network: Officially indexed contributor pages or public contributor listings.
source_type_definitions.github: Public GitHub repositories or gists with reproducible prompt assets.
source_type_definitions.paper: Public papers, reports, or appendices describing prompt structure.
source_type_definitions.local: Local project prompts already present in this repository.
source_type_definitions.social: Social posts or screenshots; do not use as the main statistical source.

sources.source_ref: Official SAIR Stage1 public overview, benchmark data, judge repo, and released final evaluation subsets.
sources.license_or_tos_note: Verify per released asset before mirroring raw text.
sources.recommended_use: primary corpus backbone and benchmark provenance anchor

sources.source_ref: Local prompt candidates already tracked in prompts/complete within this repository.
sources.license_or_tos_note: Repository-owned assets; keep provenance and release notes.
sources.recommended_use: baseline local candidate pool for taxonomy and recomputed runs

sources.source_ref: Public GitHub prompt repositories or gists with legally reusable prompt text.
sources.storage_policy: store_metadata_first_then check license before mirroring prompt text
sources.license_or_tos_note: Do not copy prompt text unless the repository license and file-level context permit it.
sources.recommended_use: supplementary public corpus source after provenance review
